title: Daegu International Culture Festival
source_body:
Daegu International Culture Festival
Travel around the world without leaving the city!

Date: Saturday, October 31 – Sunday, November 1
Time: 11:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.
Place: Duryu Park, Daegu

Programs
- Food Street: Try dishes from 12 countries, including Mexican tacos, Indian curry, and Turkish kebabs.
- Traditional Clothing Experience: Wear traditional clothes from Japan, Vietnam, and Mongolia and take photos. (Free)
- World Music Stage: Enjoy live performances every two hours, starting at noon. The last show begins at 4:00 p.m.
- Language Corner: Learn basic greetings in five languages.

Tickets
- Adults: 8,000 won
- Students (ages 13–18): 5,000 won
- Children under 13: Free
※ Students must show their student ID card at the entrance.

Special Event
Collect stamps from at least five country booths and get a free festival T-shirt! (Only for the first 300 visitors each day)

Please note: Pets are not allowed inside the festival area. Visitors are encouraged to bring their own reusable cups and bags.
